curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Start with the pre-drive habits, then cover the two brake systems, bumper rules for cars versus pickups and vans, the horn and when to use it, and the required equipment list.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per equipment rule, with a contrast card for car bumpers versus pickup and van bumpers.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz asking whether a described vehicle has the equipment it needs.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain required headlights and taillights, the high beam distance, care of headlights, daytime running lights, when headlights must be on, and plate and signal lights.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each lighting rule, with contrast cards for the three hundred fifty versus five hundred foot distances and daytime running lights versus headlights.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz giving a time and weather condition and asking whether headlights must be on.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover which vehicles may use blue, flashing and strobe lights, then the muffler, mirror, seat belt and airbag rules.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per rule, with contrast cards for blue versus flashing versus strobe lights and for seat belts versus airbags.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz asking whether a described vehicle may use a given light, and what mirrors or belts are required.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Walk through tire inspection, grip on loose roads, pressure loss, where to find the right pressure and when to check it, the legal tread limit and the penny test.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each tire rule, with contrast cards for the door sticker versus the sidewall and the tread limit versus the penny test.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on tire scenarios asking what pressure to use or whether a tire is legal.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain clear-view rules, what may go on a windshield, reflective and darkening materials, tint labels and limits, wipers and defrosters, and fenders.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per glass rule, with contrast cards for allowed stickers versus hanging objects and the transmit versus reflect tint limits.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz asking whether a described windshield or window setup is legal.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Close with vehicle care, driving habits and travel choices that save fuel.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card for maintenance, one for driving habits and one for travel choices.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz asking which habit saves fuel.
